summary: The test audit graded all 59 criteria against the tests at d0dd3cf. 16 are Adequate and 43 are Weak; none is Missing, no mapped test fails or is skipped, and nothing is unbuilt, blocked or changed outside the requirements. Six red checks broke the riskiest part of AC-FINAL-01 and five other Adequate criteria in different test files, and every one went red. The Weak rows mostly lack a test for one or two stated parts, often a screen's wording or a path only a browser exercises, and seven of them are high risk: AC-STAGE-04, AC-STAGE-06, AC-PLAN-08, AC-PLAN-03, AC-TALK-02, AC-MODEL-06 and AC-HOME-05. The fixing work is planned in test-audit.md in six batches, high-risk rows first. No delivery audit has run since phases 11 and 12 were built.

needsYou.problem: Kiln's checkpoint hook again reported "Kiln checkpoint unavailable: Admission lock is unresolved; retry reconciliation" throughout this audit. It cut off most fourth-round assessors after a few tool calls, some more than once, and blocked some of their Bash calls. The live attempt's gate.json under the PRD's Kiln state directory reached 16.7 MB during this audit. Every tool call of every parallel sub-agent waits on admission.lock while withGate in src/live/gate.ts reads and fsync-rewrites that file, and the lock gives up after 5 seconds.
needsYou.action: Look at gate.json growth and the 5-second admission deadline in src/live/gate.ts (live-attempts under the PRD's Kiln state directory). Many parallel sub-agents exceed that deadline, so delivery and test audits keep losing assessors.

needsYou.problem: AC-STAGE-04 is high risk and its tests are Weak: no test shows billing checked before a feedback or review session launches, or approval before Start covering applying feedback, so a break could start metered sessions without approval. The pause, Resume and restart parts named in test-audit.md are also untested.
needsYou.action: Let the test-fix sessions work batch 1 of test-audit.md, or accept the row if its gaps are acceptable.
